scope: Four independently reset finite RTL cases instantiate the actual generated HLS03 adapter SHA42f9056, actual F10 caller-consumption shell, frozen PASS LPV-owner sidecar, and exactly one actual managed AXI portal/transport/monitor/hub. Actual first LTX FIFO pop starts sidecar ownership; actual final 16th LTC caller pop releases it. All candidate/pending/response complete A and route metadata come from the sidecar actual handshakes. A comes from the actual portal whole record admission handshake and remains installed after local transaction drain. Independent frozen literals verify every actual 24 LTX, 16 raw generated LPV, 8 actual portal LPA and generated adapter pops, and 16 normalized LTC writes and caller pops. Actual HLS semantic state/beat/cancel_at_accept must return to zero; no ap_ctrl helper or idle signal substitutes for final caller drain. Controlled LTX, A-install, link-backpressure and AXI producer/memory peers are explicit. A producer-local finish obligation is created by actual upstream AW and clears only on its controlled valid/ready finish after actual final B; this is independent of sidecar.txn_drained. Case0 normal CLAIM/BEGIN/wrong-origin END/matching error END/INVALIDATE includes held final B, held producer fence, unique terminal task and next LTX queued during LTC tail2/tail1. Case1 cancel occurs only after the real END first LTX pop and two actual raw LPV pushes; old raw/portal partial frames, LPA tail2/tail1, actual return FIFO and LTC tails drain with old A/route and one terminal. Case2 already presented successful CLAIM return survives revoke without inventing physical or typed retirement. Case3 normal CLAIM-only/INVALIDATE cleans the owner with no BEGIN, AXI or typed task. Frozen sidecar sticky txn_revoked blocks NEW post-revoke cleanup; both cancelled cases explicitly observe that known gap with cleanup first2 physically queued. No cleanup after revoke is admitted or claimed, and D-M003-EXECUTOR-OLD-LTX-CLEANUP-01 implementation is deferred to a separately owned interface change. No generated executor/program/LN, full tensor, same-runtime C chain, source AR/F9 validator, CLOSE/rearm, joint resources, new timing, OOC/P&R or board claim. Original HLS03 FAIL receipt remains FAIL; independent top-only port inspection supplies limited 8-FIFO/no-top-ap_ctrl facts, not a rewritten HLS verdict.
